# IO scope. True when Prefecture p has at least one restless/disloyal theme (loyalty < 40).
oe_theme_ui_p1_has_restless = {
    scope = international_organization
    is_shown = {
        any_international_organization_member = {
            oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
            oe_theme_in_prefecture_1 = yes
            has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty } var:oe_theme_loyalty < 40 }
        }
    }
}
